title: The 'call it a draw between them' option, used successfully three times to settle companion quarrels with no relationship cost, failed its roll on its fourth use and cost standing with BOTH companions at once ('Tamsin disapproves (-1). Vell disapproves (-1)') — a worse outcome on a miss than simply backing one side, which only ever costs one relationship.
